title: FBI Photo B1
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO consisting of a single redacted infrared still image and a descriptive narrative.

incidents.summary: A grainy, monochrome infrared still image showing a small, dark, circular object near a crosshair reticle against a background of indistinct terrain.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, circular object is visible in the upper right quadrant
